title: Dabigatran for thromboprophylaxis after elective arthroplasty
question: In adults undergoing elective hip or knee arthroplasty, does dabigatran prevent venous thromboembolism compared with the comparator each trial actually randomised against?
why_this_is_its_own_question: Prophylaxis in a surgical population is a different question from treatment, and most trials here count venographically detected events that no treatment trial looks for.

split_from.why: The parent's four trials span three different readings plus one that is not a VTE trial. Choosing one reading would have discarded the other questions silently, so the topic was SPLIT rather than narrowed.

Total Venous Thromboembolic Event (VTE) includes both proximal and distal deep vein thrombosis (DVT) (detected by routine bilateral venography), symptomatic DVT (confirmed by venous compression ultrasound, venography or autopsy) and pulmonary embolism (PE) (confirmed by pulmonary V-Q scintigraphy, chest x-ray, pulmonary angiography, spiral CT or autopsy).

restricted_subsets_that_survive_the_name.caveat_on_the_title_grouping: Titles are grouped by EXACT text, so this count is a LOWER BOUND. NCT00168818 registers 'Total Venous Thromboembolic Event and All-cause Mortality During Treatment Period' while NCT00152971 and NCT00657150 register the same words prefixed 'Number of Participants With'. Loosening the match would be comparing endpoints on their titles, which is the exact error P37 names -- so the grouping stays exact and the components are read by a human instead.

Compared on their verbatim text, not on the word 'composite'. AUTHORITY: MECIR Box 10.10.a C62 -- undertake or display a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are sufficiently similar to ensure a clinically meaningful answer -- and Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.3, 'A systematic review need not contain any meta-analyses.'

primary.what_this_does_not_establish: NOT that any trial here is poor. NOT that dabigatran is ineffective in this population. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area -- a comparator-restricted subset is named on this object where one exists. Only that the trials as they stand do not estimate one common quantity.
primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.
